name: BMW G310GS
intro: BMW's small adventure single. Early bikes had side stand and brake caliper recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2018 G310GS bikes are in recall 18V408 (side stand and frame). 2018-2020 bikes are in recall 19V593 (brake calipers may corrode).

recalls.what: Repeated side stand use can damage the stand and the frame, and the bike may fall over.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits a reinforcement plate and new stand, or replaces the frame, free.

recalls.what: Front and rear brake calipers may corrode and stick or drag.
